items.name: Plaza Azteca birria ramen (rolls logged separately)
items.portion: 1 bowl; assumed 110 g dry ramen equivalent, 170 g cooked beef, broth/fat and aromatics
items.note: User reports dinner November 4, 2026 at Plaza Aztec; exact location/name not verified. Provisional high-side ingredient estimate, NOT restaurant-published nutrition. Photo img_7c14c59a433e.jpeg shows noodles, beef, orange oily broth, onion/cilantro and separate tortilla-looking sides. Portions are assumptions, not measurements. Follow-up confirms both tortilla sides consumed; logged separately as two birria rolls based on the official Virginia menu. Exact branch remains unknown. Working model: 110 g dry ramen equivalent (USDA 171177: 484 kcal, P11.22 C66.33 F19.36), 170 g braised chuck eye with fat (USDA 173099: 428.4 kcal, P50.83 C0 F24.99), about 9 g additional broth fat (81 kcal), and roughly 10 kcal onion/cilantro/chile (about 2 g carbs). Rounded to 1000 kcal, P62 C68 F53. Beef cut, noodle quantity, broth consumed and retained fat are unknown; full reported bowl is the working consumption assumption. Sources: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/171177/nutrients ; https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/173099/nutrients .

items.name: Plaza Azteca birria rolls (both sides)
items.portion: 2 rolls consumed; tortilla, meat and frying-fat amounts estimated
items.note: User explicitly confirms eating BOTH tortilla sides shown in img_7c14c59a433e.jpeg. Official Virginia menu describes Birria Ramen: "Ramen noodles in a rich consomé with tender meat, topped with onions and cilantro. Served with a 2 birria rolls perfect to dip in your ramen." Thus recorded as two birria rolls, not verified cheese taquitos. Menu verifies accompaniment identity/count, NOT nutrition or exact filling recipe. Exact branch unknown; this menu is linked for multiple Richmond-area locations, not proof of branch visited. Provisional high-side ingredient model for BOTH rolls together: two flour tortillas totaling about 80 g (~250 kcal, P7 C42 F6), about 85 g cooked beef (~214 kcal, P25 C0 F12.5; same USDA 173099 basis as ramen), and 10 g retained frying fat (~90 kcal, F10). Sum ~554 kcal, P32 C42 F28.5, rounded to 550 kcal, P32 C42 F29. Tortilla type/weight, filling and retained oil are unmeasured assumptions; cheese is not separately assumed. Nutrition is an ingredient estimate, NOT restaurant-published nutrition. Added once separately from unchanged 1000-kcal ramen and unchanged 450-kcal chips. Menu source: https://plazaazteca.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/PA-FOOD-MENU-VIRGINIA-1224-V2-25.5x11-WEB-SMALL.pdf ; beef source: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/173099/nutrients .
